newsitem.title: CANADA: CP Rail mainline reopened Sunday.
newsitem.headline: CP Rail mainline reopened Sunday.

text.p: CP Rail System's main line between Dryden and Thunder Bay reopened mid-morning Sunday after a freight train hauling hazardous goods derailed east of Ignace Friday at 1500 CST, a CP spokesman said.
"There were some delays. We did re-route some trains in certain cases but not all of the trains can be rerouted so there were some delays," CP spokesman Steve Morris said.
No one was injured when 24 railcars jumped the track.
Four of the railcars that jumped the track were carrying hazardous goods when the train derailed in an uninhabited wooded area 12 kilometers east of Ignace.
The cause of the derailment was still under investigation.
